The 72×36 intertwining constraints for a transposition and 5-cycle have exact rank 35 mod 101, so Q-rank ≥35; the known nonzero U implies ≤35. Since U has entry 1, integer equivariant Hom=Z U; nonzero maps have index 2|m|^6. The cokernel Z/2 has trivial S5/Galois action, so dual tori yield 1→μ2→J_D→T_B→1, including nonreduced kernel in characteristic two. The finite group identity is exhaustive, not sample induction; geometric normalisation/torus descent is separate proof.
